programme.title: The Making of King Arthur

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.sub-title: Michael Palin Remembers... Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Few people have followed in Ernest Hemingway's footsteps quite like Michael Palin. In this fascinating interview, the much-loved broadcaster, writer and traveller reflects on his journey through the landscapes, cultures and stories that shaped one of the 20th century's most celebrated authors. From Hemingway's homes and favourite haunts to the adventures that inspired his greatest works, Michael shares the highlights of his travels, revealing what he learned about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin follows Ernest Hemingway's footsteps across Europe, Africa and America. He starts in Spain for Pamplona's bull run, Valencia's bullfighting and a Kenyan safari.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin moves from the busy streets of Chicago to a suburb of Oak Park, Illinois. Here, in a town that Hemingway apparently called a place of `wide lawns and narrow minds', his ambitious and creative mother dressed him as a girl and wrote some melancholy music. Later, in Michigan, Michael visits the family summer cottage.

programme.title: Windrush: Portraits of a Generation
programme.desc: Marking the 75th anniversary of the arrival of HMT Empire Windrush by following a remarkable project spearheaded by King Charles III, who has commissioned ten leading artists to create portraits of ten pioneering members of the Windrush Generation.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn mynd i weld Syrcas Chwain ac yn gyffrous iawn - ond mae Macsen yn taro'r llwyfan ar ddamwain. The Wee Littles are going to a Flea Circus, and are very excited.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Does Gan Hipo Ddim Blew?
programme.desc: There was a time when Hippo did have hair, lots of hair! She was always unbearably hot. Then one hot night while Hippo was sleeping, a spark from the fire caught the end of her hairy tail. Hippo was on fire, and she ran through the bush until she jumped in the waterhole. From then on Hippo stayed in the cool waters without a single hair on her hide.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Pwy fydd y môr-ladron sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma? From which school will these pirates come, to join Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure?

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Mae Siôn ac Izzy'n gwarchod Bea ond maen nhw'n tynnu gwallt o'u pennau pan mae'n crïo'n ddiddiwedd. Siôn and Izzy offer to babysit Baby Bea, but a crying baby proves to be quite a handful.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Byddwn yn teithio i Baris i ddysgu am Pierre Lallement, y dyn wnaeth greu'r beic gyda phedalau nol yn 1863. Discovering how bikes work and about the different types of bikes, such as motorbikes.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mi fydd Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion ledled Cymru yn trafod pob math o bynciau. Wythnos yma, Gwyliau ydi'r pwnc trafod. This week, holidays is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae'r igian sydd ar Blero'n achosi tirlithriad. Fydd e'n gallu dod o hyd i'w ffordd adre? Blero's hiccups cause a landslide. Can he stop and find his way home?

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Mae Lewis yn holi, 'Beth yw Mellt a Tharanau' a dyma Tad-cu'n dechrau ar stori sili arall am chwilen o'r enw Cranogwen oedd yn ofn y glaw. Lewis asks about thunder and lightning, Grandfather tells a story about a beetle who was afraid of rain.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Ar drip i'r traeth mae Pablo a'r anifeiliaid yn canu cân, ond pam bod cefnder Draff yn mynnu eu gwahardd rhag gwneud? Pablo is off to the beach when he and the animals decide to sing a song.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae teulu swnllyd yn cyrraedd Parc Glan Gwil ac yn creu trafferth. Mae'n rhaid i'r criw feddwl am ffordd o'u tawelu. A noisy family arrive in Parc Glan Gwil and create trouble.

programme.title: Byd Carlo Bach
programme.desc: Wil Carlo's map lead him to the pirates' treasure?

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Sara isie neud fideo roc o Trefor Ifans a'i iwcalele. Mae pethau'n mynd o chwith a Sam yw'r seren ond mae Trefor yn rocio! Sarah wants to make a rock video of Trevor and his ukulele.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamboree! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Digbi thinks Betsi will be delighted with the tricks box he has found in Abel's shop.

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: Wwww a Eeee yw rhai o'r synau rhyfedd sy'n dod o'r fferm heddiw, ond beth sy'n anarferol amdanyn nhw? `Wwww' and `eeee' are some of the strange sounds coming from the farm today. Jim and Jen try to solve the mystery of the noises.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Yn y rhaglen hon, anifeiliaid sy'n dda am gydweddu a'u hamgylchedd sy'n cael y sylw - sef y morgathod a'r llewpard. An opportunity to meet two very different animals: the ray and the leopard.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: The Octonauts struggle to save a pod of spinner dolphins who seem to be swimming in their sleep.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Helpa Odo Pen Bandit i glirio ac ail agor y llwybrau Natur sy wedi cau o gwmpas Maes y Mes. Odo helps Camp Leader to clear and open up some Nature trails.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Cyflymder sy'n denu Jet-boi, ond mae Jet-dad eisio iddo roi cynnig ar rywbeth newydd. As Cwstenin Cranc interrupts Jet-boy and Jet-dad's practice, an opportunity emerges.

programme.title: Waw!
programme.desc: Y corff sy'n cael sylw Awi a chriw Waw y tro yma. The body gets the attention of Awi and the crew.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'n fore oer yn y ddôl ac mae'r Pitws Bychain am wneud dillad cynnes efo help dafad gyfeillgar. It's a cold morning, and The Wee Littles decide that they should make some warmer clothes.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Cheetah didn't have tears. She was the fastest animal in the whole of Tinga Tinga, and even faster than Wind. Every year Cheetah and Wind would race to see who was the fastest and every year Cheetah would win.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: A fydd Mor Ladron o Ysgol y Ffwrnes yn medru helpu achub Ynys Bendibelliawn o ddwylo Capten Cnec? Will the pirates from Ysgol y Ffwrnes be able to help save the island of Bendibelliawn from Captain Cnec?

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Byddwn yn dysgu am awyrennau yn y bennod yma, a phwy wnaeth ddyfeisio ac adeiladu'r awyren gyntaf. A lesson on aeroplanes and the person responsible for the invention of the aeroplane.
